# 103. Upgrade CouchDB to 3.5.3

**Date:** 2026-10-24

**Optional per env:** _required on all environments_


## CommCare Version Dependency
This change is not known to be dependent on any particular version of CommCare.


## Change Context
The default CouchDB version is now 3.5.3.

## Details
CouchDB 3.5.3 is the latest 3.5 release and is published for both Ubuntu 22.04
and 26.04. CouchDB 3.5.0 packages are not available for Ubuntu 26.04.

Environments that set `couchdb_version` in `public.yml` keep that
version until it is changed.

## Steps to update
If your environment runs CouchDB 3.3.x, first upgrade to 3.5.0 as
described in [Rolling Upgrade of CouchDB Nodes](0098-couchdb-upgrade.md).

Then set the version in `environments/<env>/public.yml`:

```yaml
couchdb_version: "3.5.3"
```

and upgrade each CouchDB node, one at a time, using steps 1 to 4 of
[Rolling Upgrade of CouchDB Nodes](0098-couchdb-upgrade.md).
